body:
This looks great! It would be really nice to have, especially considering it means all our list sorting algorithms will be merged (no pun intended).

Unfortunately, I don't know anything about merge sort, so I can't confidently review this :/
I'm not sure if we have a sorting expert among the maintainers?

Alright, since nobody else has reviewed this PR, I think it's time to move forward with it.

I checked your code and interfaces, it looks great to me. I only vibe checked the actual merge sort logic, but it's a well established algorithm, and you have unit tests and benchmarks. Plus, your past PRs have been very reliable, so I'll trust you got it right :)

Could you rebase to make sure unit tests still pass?
